notes_for_human: PRIORITY FIELD RESULT: Morgan Stanley publishes NO reapplication rule, NO post-rejection waiting period, NO assessment/HireVue retake rule, and NO firm-wide cap on number of applications on any page retrieved. The single cap found is the IBD posting's within-one-application preference limit (3 offices, 3 IBD groups) — do not let that be read as an application cap. The firm's EMEA Early Insight FAQ, the most probable location for a real cap, timed out twice and is the top retry target. Two aggregator claims were seen and deliberately EXCLUDED for lack of a primary source: (a) a '9 applications per year / 3 intern' IBD cap, and (b) a 2022 Early Insights one-application rule. Both are plausible and both are unverified — do not publish them. Also note the compensation figure $52.89/hour appears identically on both the IBD and Wealth Management 2027 postings, which is consistent but worth a second check. The Freshman Enhancement row is stale (prior cycle) and is flagged as such rather than dropped, because it documents the program's existence and structure; its graduation window must not be presented as 2027-cycle eligibility.
